a. What is the rate of change when y = 0?

`r devoirs::devoirs_set(c(-6, -4, 4, 6, "greater than 6"), correct = "greater than 6", id="D-07-back", sort = TRUE)`

b. At what value of the input is the function output the greatest?

`r devoirs::devoirs_set(c(-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5 ), correct = 1.5, id="D-07-aura")`

c. What is the rate of change of the function when the input is at the value in question (b)?

`r devoirs::devoirs_set(c(-4, -2, 0, 2, 4), correct = 0, id="D-07-fir")`

d. At what value of the input is the function output the smallest?

`r devoirs::devoirs_set(c(-1.5, -0.5, 0.5, 1.5 ), correct = -1.5, id="D-07-jog")`

e. What is the rate of change of the function when the input is at the value in question (b)?

`r devoirs::devoirs_set(c(-4, -2, 0, 2, 4), correct = 0, id="D-07-mair")`
